rootCauseClassification.type: C) DIFFERENT DTC ID NORMALIZATION / CASE SENSITIVITY
rootCauseClassification.description: On Windows file systems (case-insensitive), fs.readdirSync() returned lowercase filenames (e.g. p0300.json) alongside uppercase names (P0300.json), causing un-normalized string comparison in Gate 7 script to count them twice. UpperCase normalization resolved the 7-record discrepancy.
